_about: Fields PayPal requires that the Postman collection does not mark as required, found when the sandbox rejected a call (400 MISSING_REQUIRED_PARAMETER). Each value is what is sent when the user did not set the field. Only values with no meaning of their own belong here: an empty object PayPal fills with its defaults. Details only the user can decide (an item name, a recipient) are asked for instead (agent/ready.py).
